card.name: Drug name or 'that' before an effect verb
card.fires_on: The last word of a drug subject (end of a drug name, 'that' after 'drugs', or 'inhibitors') in interaction text, right before a verb like increase, decrease, affect, inhibit or cause.

modes.label: End of drug name
modes.description: The final piece of a drug name that is the subject of a sentence about its effect.
modes.example: Both digitalis and acebutol<<ol>> impair AV conduction.

modes.label: 'that' after drug
modes.description: The word 'that' introducing a clause about what the drug or class does.
modes.example: caution is advised when citalopram is co-administered with other drugs<< that>> may affect the serotonergic neurotransmitter

modes.label: Drug class noun
modes.description: A class word such as inhibitors just before its effect verb.
modes.example: Positive Urine Glucose Test Clinical Impact SGLT2<< inhibitors>> increase urinary glucose excretion and will lead
